message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 19 cards each + 8 special cards) |
| **Players** | 2–10 (standard rules; 2–4 recommended for casual play) |
| **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied after each round when a player goes “Uno” or wins. |

---

### 1. Setup

| Step | Action |
|------|--------|
| 1 | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. |
| 2 | Place the remaining deck face down as the draw pile. |
| 3 | Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately. |
| 4 | Determine who goes first (e.g., highest card, random). |

---

### 2. Turn Sequence

| Phase | What Happens |
|-------|--------------|
| **Draw** | If you cannot play a card from your hand, draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately. |
| **Play** | Place one card from your hand onto the discard pile that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top card. |
| **Action** | If you play a special card, execute its effect on the next player(s). |
| **Uno** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty. |
| **End** | If you play your last card, you win the round. |

---

### 3. Card Types & Effects

| Card | Effect |
|------|--------|
| **Number Cards (0–9)** | Standard play; no special effect. |
| **Skip** | Next player loses their turn. |
| **Reverse** | Reverses the direction of play (clockwise ↔ counter‑clockwise). |
| **Draw Two (+2)** | Next player draws two cards and misses their turn. |
| **Wild** | Player chooses the new color. |
| **Wild Draw Four (+4)** | Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and misses their turn. *Can only be played if you have no matching color cards.* |

> **Note:** The “+4” rule is optional; some groups allow it to be challenged.

---

### 4. Winning a Round

| Condition | Points Awarded |
|-----------|----------------|
| You finish all your cards | Sum of all cards in opponents’ hands (number cards = face value; Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20; Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50). |
| Opponent finishes first | Same point calculation. |
| You’re the first to reach the target score (e.g., 500) | Game ends. |

---

### 5. Common Variations

| Variation | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **House Rules** | Many groups add house rules such as “draw two” on a “wild draw four” or “no challenge” for +4. |
| **Speed Uno** | Players must play as fast as possible; no timeouts. |
| **Uno Attack** | Uses a special electronic card dispenser that randomly throws out cards. |
| **Uno Flip** | Adds a second side to each card with different colors and effects. |

---

### 6. Tips & Strategy

| Tip | Why It Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| Keep a balanced hand (mix of colors and numbers). | Increases flexibility to match the discard pile. |
| Save “+4” for when you’re sure you have no matching color. | Avoids penalties if challenged. |
| Pay attention to the discard pile’s color changes. | Allows you to anticipate upcoming plays. |
| Use “Skip” and “Reverse” strategically to protect yourself or target opponents. | Can change the flow of the game. |

---

**Quick Reference Cheat Sheet**

| Card | Symbol | Value | Effect |
|------|--------|-------|--------|
| 0–9 | Number | Face value | None |
| Skip | ⛔ | 20 | Skip next player |
| Reverse | 🔁 | 20 | Reverse direction |
| Draw Two | ➕2 | 20 | Next player draws 2 |
| Wild | 🎨 | 50 | Choose color |
| Wild Draw Four | 🎨➕4 | 50 | Choose color; next draws 4 |

Enjoy playing Uno!
